fact: Leaving the track without a justifiable reason multiple times.
offence: Breach of Article 33.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations, Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 c) of the International Sporting Code. and the Race Directors' Event Notes Art 18.1 - Article 12.2.1 i) of the International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video and in-car video evidence. Car 10 left the track on 4 occasions, and having received the black and white flag after the 3rd time, the standard 5 second penalty is applied.
rules_referenced: Article 33.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 10 Leaving The Track Without A Justifiable Reason Multiple Times
to: The Team Manager, BWT Alpine Formula 1 Team
